name: aigent-os
description: Mods for aigent-OS: Claude Code plugins of function hooks.

plugins.name: fleet-band
plugins.description: Read-only fleet status band above the prompt, plus /fires, /pending and /held commands that answer with no model turn.

plugins.name: fleet-delivery
plugins.description: Delivers a seat's Room inbox and pending job results into the session through the prompt API, one prompt per item. Inert until the owner switch is flipped for that seat.

plugins.name: context-capsule
plugins.description: Write a resume-ready capsule of your session, then /clear or auto-compact and pick up where you left off. Adds /capsule, /refresh and /resume plus SessionStart and PreCompact hooks. Zero dependencies, no network.
